versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Introduces a skill to help users and support teams generate clearer error messages that explain what failed, why, and what to do next.
- Includes detailed workflow, validation criteria, and templates for consistent outputs.
- Supports common needs around error messages, user feedback, debugging, practical workflows, and troubleshooting.
- Designed to be local-hardware friendly, preferring scripts, templates, and checklists over cloud-only solutions.
- Clearly outlines triggers and usage scenarios.

- Initial release of error-message-improver skill.
- Helps users and support teams create clearer error messages explaining what failed, why, and next steps.
- Supports application developers, SaaS operators, and end users to improve troubleshooting efficiency.
- Provides concise workflows, templates, and checklists for error message improvement.
- Includes validation criteria and triggers for practical usage in work-productivity, debugging, and support scenarios.
